questions.q: Why does a Subflow need a defined Inputs section at all?
options: Because a subflow has no Trigger and no record is handed to it automatically, so anything it needs must be passed in explicitly
Because ServiceNow requires every record to have at least one input field
Because inputs are only used for formatting the subflow's name
Because subflows cannot read data from any record
questions.explain: With no Trigger of its own, a subflow has no automatic record context — its Inputs section defines exactly what the calling flow must hand it.

questions.q: What does a Subflow's Outputs section define?
options: The list of users allowed to run the subflow
A named, typed list of exactly what the subflow hands back to the calling flow once it finishes
The trigger condition that starts the subflow
The number of times the subflow can be called
questions.explain: Outputs are what the subflow returns when it completes — for example, a Decision and a Decision Date — making its internal results visible to whatever called it.

questions.q: In the parameter/return-value analogy this lesson uses, what matches a subflow's Outputs?
options: A function's parameters
A function's variable names
A function's return value
A function's comments
questions.explain: Inputs behave like parameters (what the subflow needs to run); Outputs behave like a return value (what it hands back once it's done).

questions.q: How does a calling flow actually supply values to a subflow's defined Inputs?
options: By writing a JavaScript function that calls the subflow directly
Through a Call Subflow–style action, mapping data pills from the flow's own context into each defined input
Inputs are filled in automatically with no configuration needed
By editing the subflow's own trigger condition
questions.explain: The Call Subflow action's configuration panel shows the subflow's defined inputs, and the flow builder maps its own data pills into them.

questions.q: Once a subflow finishes running, how can the calling flow use its Outputs?
options: It cannot use them at all once the subflow finishes
Only by re-running the subflow a second time
They become new data pills available in every step after the Call Subflow action, usable for branching or writing to a record
Only a system administrator can retrieve them manually
questions.explain: A subflow's outputs surface as data pills in the calling flow immediately after the Call Subflow action, selectable in any later step just like any other data pill.
